description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Murphy Door is seeking a Full-Stack Software Developer to build and maintain technology supporting its e-commerce platforms, manufacturing operations, and business systems. The role works across web applications, storefronts, 3D configurators, rendering workflows, integrations, and production applications with a small in-house engineering team.
Full-stack e-commerce developer building Shopify applications, storefronts, 3D configurators, and business-system integrations

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain features in our custom Shopify application using Remix, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL
• Develop and improve Shopify storefronts for Murphy Door and Ultra Shelf using Liquid, JavaScript, and CSS
• Support and enhance our interactive 3D product configurator built with three.js
• Work with Python, Blender, Docker, and AWS to maintain automated product-rendering workflows
• Develop and troubleshoot integrations with Shopify APIs, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, marketing platforms, and other business systems
• Support our Purebrand platform using Django, React, and Node/PHP alongside contract developers
• Write automated tests using tools such as Vitest, Playwright, and Cypress
• Participate in code reviews, version control, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub and GitHub Actions
• Help maintain reliable production applications using AWS services such as EC2, ECS, and CloudWatch
• Use AI-assisted coding tools, including Claude Code, to improve development efficiency while maintaining code quality
• Collaborate with a small engineering team to troubleshoot issues, develop solutions, and improve business operations

Requirements:
• 1–3+ years of professional web application development experience, or equivalent experience through internships, personal projects, or a strong portfolio
• Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and React skills
• Working knowledge of Node.js and SQL databases, preferably PostgreSQL
• Comfortable working across front-end and back-end development
• Working knowledge of Python
• Experience with Git, pull requests, and code reviews
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Ability to learn unfamiliar codebases and technologies
• Self-motivated, dependable, and comfortable working in a collaborative environment
• We encourage strong recent graduates to apply
• Demonstrated ability, technical projects, and a willingness to learn are valuable to our team

Preferred:
• Shopify app or theme development, Liquid, Polaris, or Admin GraphQL APIs
• Remix, React Router, Prisma, or Tailwind CSS
• AWS, Docker, or cloud application deployments
• three.js, WebGL, Blender, or 3D rendering technologies
• Django or PHP
• ERP or e-commerce system integrations
• Automated testing and CI/CD pipelines
• AI-assisted development tools
